title: Prove stale-claim CAS takeover fencing on real GitHub
objective: Exercise the live claim path with an intentionally expired generation-1 owner, a valid generation-2 takeover, and a second contender attempting to replace the same old Git blob SHA. Exactly one takeover may win.
acceptance: generation-1 claim is expired before takeover
generation-2 owner identifies takeoverOf generation-1 worker
transition validator accepts the legitimate takeover
second contender using stale generation-1 blob SHA is rejected by GitHub
old owner is fenced by changed worker/token/generation
